control: Fresh corrected-environment lambda=.98, same frozen90 weights, first training seed and 4M budget. Historical old-environment pilot is excluded as a training control.

failure_rule: Incomplete execution is INCOMPLETE, positive uncertain effects INCONCLUSIVE; no joint gain stops recipe extension; Act1 reach is diagnostic only.
